home.about_text: PSMA (POCUS Students & Residents Medical Alliance) is the student and resident division of the Japanese Society of Point-of-Care Ultrasound. Through the study of ultrasound medicine and POCUS (Point-of-Care Ultrasound), we aim to connect students, residents, and young healthcare professionals — fostering growth and building the future of medicine together.
home.feature_1_text: We host hands-on seminars using real probes. Whether in-person or online, we provide a space where students and residents can learn ultrasound.
home.feature_2_text: We connect healthcare students and residents nationwide, providing opportunities for information sharing and collaborative learning.
home.feature_3_text:
We share founding stories and operational know-how from across Japan.
From launching an ultrasound club to sustaining it long-term, we support student-led initiatives.

about.title: About PSMA
about.mission_statement: For healthcare students and young professionals to learn across university, regional, and year boundaries — and together build a better future for medicine.
about.mission_tagline_1: From one person's learning, to a community's.
about.mission_tagline_2: From one connection, to the whole nation.
about.mission_tagline_3: And from here, to the next generation.
about.vision_statement: To create an environment where every healthcare student and young professional — regardless of university or location — can meet peers, learn, and take on challenges.
about.vision_body_1: PSMA connects healthcare students and young professionals across Japan, sharing knowledge and experience to generate learning and growth that no one could achieve alone.
about.vision_body_2: Respecting each other's expertise and values, we go beyond the one-way relationship of teacher and student — aiming for a community where everyone becomes a contributor to learning.
about.promise_1_statement: Take the first step without fear of failure.
about.promise_1_body: We welcome new ideas and act together with peers to make them real.
about.promise_2_statement: Pass what you've learned on to the next person.
about.promise_2_body: We give back our learning and opportunities to the community and the next generation.
about.promise_3_statement: Build the future of medicine with our own hands.
about.promise_3_body: We face challenges proactively and create change that leads to better education and healthcare.
about.history_text: PSMA (POCUS Students & Residents Medical Alliance) is the student and resident division of the Japanese Society of Point-of-Care Ultrasound. Through the study of ultrasound medicine and POCUS (Point-of-Care Ultrasound), we aim to connect students, residents, and young healthcare professionals — fostering growth and building the future of medicine together.

activities.title: Our Activities
activities.subtitle: PSMA works to expand POCUS-centered learning and connection nationwide through study sessions, information sharing, and building learning environments.
activities.act_1_body_1: We host hands-on seminars and case discussions on ultrasound and clinical reasoning, both online and in person — open to anyone regardless of university or year.
activities.act_2_body_1: We share POCUS learning, conference activities, and practices from across Japan — creating opportunities for more people to connect with POCUS.
activities.act_3_body_1: We support universities and medical facilities in building POCUS learning environments, sharing know-how on starting groups and running events — so anyone can learn POCUS close to home.
activities.upcoming_empty: Events are being planned. Follow our social media for the latest updates.
